draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
rationale: The evidence only evaluates Banking and Travel, the training domains. No unseen-domain evaluation exists, so the claim that the advantage "may extend" to unseen domains is unsupported speculation. No defensible narrower version remains.
